---
name: HealthVault-Task-Execution
description: Execute read-only HealthVault tasks with explicit evidence, validation, and a reusable validator-passed workflow.
---

## When to Use
Use for HealthVault timeline, indicator comparison, knowledge search, and visit-brief tasks, especially repeated validator-passed requests.

## Prerequisites
Use only the tools exposed by the HealthVault runtime and the injected profile context.

## Steps
1. Identify the requested HealthVault outcome before selecting a tool.
2. Run only approved read-only domain tools and preserve returned citations.
3. For repeated validator-passed tasks, apply the standard read-only workflow in order:
   a. query_health_timeline (expect status=ok)
   b. compare_health_indicators (expect status=ok)
   c. generate_visit_brief (expect status=ok)
4. After an explicit correction, keep the requested read-only scope unchanged and re-validate the final citations.
5. Return the tool status accurately; never present a rejection as success.

## Failure Handling
If evidence is insufficient or a tool rejects input, report that result without guessing. Retry a deterministic tool failure only when its status explicitly permits retry; otherwise stop and report.

## Verification
Check the final status, requested fields, and every citation before answering. Confirm the workflow steps completed in order with status=ok before presenting results.

## Safety Boundaries
Never infer patient facts or medical advice, expose secrets, or invoke file, shell, MCP, or write tools.
